tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang chen mo'i dge 'dun g.yos khang gi las byed rnam gzhag gsal ston gyi yi ge las 'bras gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ sa skya'i rje btsun lnga dang sngags 'chang rje/ /'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs mkhas grub kyi/ /dam pa rnams la gus btud gdan sa che'i/ /gtsang sbyor las kyi rim pa bshad kyis nyon/ /ces brjod nas/ 'dir chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi dge 'dun gyi zhal ta gtsang sbyor ba las thog pa rim can dang / ja dpon/ tshwa gzigs/ chos khrims gzhon pa/ lag bde ba gang yod/ sbud 'bud pa gnyis bcas nas nges dgos rgyur/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud la tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod yul dam pa ni dge 'dun gyi sde yin don bzhin la/ chos grwa 'dir bla ma gong ma'i dus ja/ dgongs rdzogs chen mo/ cho 'phrul tha skar gyi smon lam rnam gnyis/ gzhan yang phyogs dang ris su ma phye ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi tshogs gsog sgrib sbyangs la 'tshogs 'du'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dug par/ sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog phul phyin bsgrub pa'i pham lhag nas las byed pa sogs kha shas la gsol ras bdag rkyen bka' drin bskyangs 'dug kyang dus phyis dge 'dun rnams las tha mal pa rnams kha drag dbang chen du song nas dge 'dun gyi sde la ji snyam du yang mi rtsi bar dbang che she mong sna tshogs zhig byas par brten/ rgyal khams spyi la bde sdug ji 'dra yod kyang / rang gis myang bas grub pa la/ dpal sa skya 'dir phan bde'i rtsa ba gdung rgyud nyag phra zhing / gdung rgyud bstan 'dzin rnams sku tshe mthar mi phyin/ dge 'dun sde rnams zhal grangs nyung zhing / mchod thebs 'bul sdud sogs lugs mi rgyug lo phyugs kha mi lta/ mnga' zhabs rnams dbul zhing phongs pa sogs nyes pa thams cad kyang gdan sa 'dir bod khrims lugs mthun ma byung ba kho nar thug 'dug pas/

da phyin chad dge 'dun gyi sde rnams gong du khur nas zhabs tog sogs phul phyin sgrub dgos rgyur/ rung khang / thab/ khro zangs/ ja snod sogs nyer spyod tshang mar nyams gso dang gsar bzhengs dgos pa thams cad las thog pa nas spyi chen la rgyu mtshan byas pas 'grub na dang / de min gdan sa gzhung du zhus ngos thams cad gtsang dag 'gad gtsang kho byed pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dngos po thams cad la sba bsri skungs sub lag len ma thon pa sogs nyes pa thams cad bsrung ngos/ char chen gyi las su 'jam tshul mchod spro zhing lhag ro rnams 'du khang sogs su bskyur nas mi 'jog par mdzo rdzi gnyis kyis bsdu nas ba mdzo la ster/ mang ja yang grangs shin tu mang na lag len 'gad mi gtsang zhing sbyin bdag gi dngos po khrol brlag dang / dge 'dun gyi sku gzugs la gnod cing / las byed rnams nyes pa lci ba bcas brgyad las mang ba mi gtong zhing / dus mdos skabs sogs sbyin bdag shin tu mang dus mgron gnyer las thog gnas tshang gsum dpang thog sbyin bdag gi ja mar/ tshwa 'o rin/ bsngo rten dang / 'o ma ngo yod rigs rnams khrung lho byang spyi gzhung grong drag gras sogs gang 'os su bcol tho rnams mig mthong du blangs nas sbyin bdag gang yin shi gson dang zhi tshogs tshogs chen gang yin kha byang gsal bkod phyag mdzod las dam dmar 'byar lho byang pho brang gang bzhugs de dang nye skor khang mig dmigs bsal zhig tu tshags byas/ mang ja dkon dus rim gtong gi bsngo zhu sogs sbyor dngos rjes gtsang byed skabs las dam gang bkod dpang po gsum gyis mig ltar byas nas gtong zhing / 'degs ja/ 'degs mar/ grol ja'i dod rnams sbyin bdag yod skabs de 'phral 'bul/ de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du mang ja'i skabs thog mar dge 'dun rnams tshogs 'phral chos khrims gzhon pas ja dpon ja mar lags zhes brda sprad pa dang /

chos khrims gzhon pas spyi khang steng nas mar gzhong blangs la ja mar sbrel/ nged rang sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbur yod tshwa gzigs chen mo rtse phyag gzhung du skor ba'i tshwa gzigs sbug shar dang / khyams stod gung gral g.yas g.yon/ rgyab gral g.yas g.yon/ de nas mkhan chen tshogs phebs yod tshe skabs 'di dang / med tshe ja khra rdzogs mtshams ༈ snga thog 'di bzhin 'dug kyang mkhan rin po che dbang phyug phun tshogs kyi sku thog la drung chen kun sangs dang / ja dpon dam chos yar 'phel gnyis gros mthun thog drung chen gnyis la skal ba med tshab mkhan chen tshogs phebs yod min la ma ltos pa rtsa bral rdzogs nas len rgyun mkhan thog gnyis la 'jags don ltar dgos tshul mkhan chen chos bkra shis nas gsungs pa 'di thams cad chos grwa chen po'i mkhan chen rim byon la bkur bzos su phul spyi pa sbu tir gang / lag bde ba nang mar thug rkyen phyed gsum re de thog nas chos khrims par tib chung re/ lag bde ba phyi mar gang / de nas rig chung gral nas bzung dge 'dun rnams kyi mchod lhag nas btsun ma dang drug mthil sngags bon rnams la snyoms nas gtong / ma chad tshe bskyar len gyis gtong zhing / lhag byung tshe rung khang la 'khur nas khro'am zangs gang 'os su ja dpon gyi ngag bkod ltar lugs gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang mchod nyan khyad nges gtong / byang la sgrub mchod sogs 'tshogs 'du gang yod dang / gzhi thog skor dag gang yod la lag bde ba rnams la ja dpon nas nyin ltar rdel rgyag gi gtong / de nas skyogs tshugs nas thog mar mkhan chen zur bzhugs pa drung chen bcas sdom mang ja re nas skyogs lnga re/ dpe mtshams par dang po la rnams nas do dang / gnyis pa rnams nas gang / de nas tshogs bcas sogs grwa rigs rnams dang / stod smad bar gsum gyi bla grwa/ bal dpon ma/ rin sgang mtshams pa g.yog bcas/ tshon snur/ skud 'don/

mal brdung sogs rin sgang nas gzhung las la phyir sdod tshang ma/ spyi pa'i lcags bzo gcig mdzo rdzi gnyis/ sbang 'don mi lnga rnams dang / lha bris pa/ gos bzo ba/ shing bzo ba rnams snga thog nas len srol yod 'dra bas de rnams dang / bzo ba'i rigs/ stod smad bar gsum gyi tshong khag gad khang gnyer/ seng ge sgo'i ma ṇi bskor mi/ spyi pa'i tsher ma bsrungs skabs mi gcig bcas de thams cad la mang ja re nas skyogs re/ spyi pa sbu tir nas btung mi spyi chen/ las thog pa/ dung mkhan/ spyi pa'i mi dpon bzhi/ drug cu chos khrims pa gnyis dang mdzod g.yog spyi pa'i shing bzo/ 'bos srag bsrung mi/ sbyin bdag gang yod rnams la drangs nas ma 'deng tshe bskyar nas len/ ja lhag byung na spyi khang nub tu khyer/ ja dpon/ tshwa gzigs pa/ sbud 'bud pa gnyis bcas la mang ja gang yod kyi dang po'i ja skal chu rtsis pas sprod cing / gnyis pa sogs skyogs nas len/ lha khang sku gnyer gzhon pa lha khang dang bde gling sgo srung lha khang rtse khang gnyer gnyis rnams nas tshul ldan byung phyin ja re nas skyogs do re/ dmigs bsal gyi bkod pa dgos pa byung tshe gdan sa gzhung dang / lha khang mkhan chen/ bde gling dbu byed rnams kyis bkod pa byung bstun gcod/ spyi khang shar du zhogs ja zo khra re/ nub tu mang ja mang nyung la ma ltos pa nyin ltar skyogs lnga re tshogs shing 'bul mi'i mgron ja'i thebs su sprod/ mang ja mang skabs skyogs pa rjes ma rnams la zangs nas rgyag yang mang ja gnyis las med tshe gnyis pa gsum pa 'dang tshod khro rang du bzhag nas/ brda byung rim bzhin khro rang nas gtong / mang ja gsum bzhi sogs yod tshe de shul du rjes ma rnams sbyor dgos pas ja khra sogs tshogs la 'gro dgos kyi snod rnams slebs 'phral gnyis pa snod rnams su lhugs shing / brda byung bstun gtong / ja lhag gang byung zangs chen du blugs/

phyi'i 'tshogs 'du'i ja lhag rnams ja dpon la rtsis sprod cing de nas 'os 'tshams ster/ lag bde ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa nas 'thung tshe snga srol bzhin/ ser 'du chen mo'i skabs 'jam mang ja chos grwa lho byang gnyis kyi mtshon ser 'du ba gang yod la go rim ma log cing mchod nyan khyad nges lhag chad med par gtong ba'i do dam las thog pa ja rgyab pa chos khrims gzhon pa ja dpon rnams 'dod pa chig sgril gyis byed/ 'jam byung skabs gzhan tshang ma mang ja 'gro khungs bzhin la/ mkhan chen tshogs phebs med skabs 'bras sum cha re dang sha lag phyed re/ 'bum ther dus mthar rnams la sha lag re bla brang du 'bul/ tshogs pa rnams la gong mchod phongs med du zhu/ spyi khang shar du zo khra gang / nub tu phru shar gang / spyi pa sbu tir 'thung mi rnams la thug rkyen gang / chos khrims par zangs krong gang dang / lag bde ba mi lnga tsam re la zangs krong du dgos gtong / cho 'phrul dang tha skar gyi smon lam gnyis la byang la tshwa gzigs sbug chung re spyi pa sbu tib/ lha khang rgyal sgo yan la thob thang gang yod gtong / gzhan gong 'og kun tu rang rang gi las khur so so la sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams nas babs thob gsol ras su gtang ba'i bka' gtan dmigs bsal re ston rgyu yod na ma gtogs gzhan btung len gnyis char yong ma 'dra bas/ slan chad 'dir mang ja 'thung mi gang yod la skal ba med cing / mang thob der ma 'thus pa rnams kyis skal len byas nas 'thus 'dra bas gong 'khod 'di bzhin dang / gtso bor ni 'jam mang ja gnyis char dge 'dun rang gi zhal du 'gro nges cis kyang gal che zhing / sbyin bdag rnams kyis mang ja'i 'degs ja rnams las/ thog pa dang spyi chen chos khrims pa gsum nas blangs pa'i bgod 'grems snga thog bzhin byed/ gal te 'di la'ang ma gnas pa'i rigs shar tshe/ btsun ma/ drug mthil/ sngags bon rnams ma gtogs gzhan dge 'dun kha tshang zhig gcod rgyu yin pas so so nas go gon dang /

rung khang gi nyer spyad tshang mar bcag dag gtsang sbra gang che/ thab steng la'ang ja dpon tshwa gzigs pa ma gtogs byung tshad mi 'gro/ dmigs bsal dgos na ja dpon nas bkod pa byed/ rung khang du'ang snga thog gi yong khungs gang yod las mi byung tshad mi 'jug ser 'du rnams ma gtogs tshogs shing tshang ma las thog pas mda' ma gtugs par sgrub pa sogs mdor na 'dir dgos dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog tshang ma bstan don la rgyar phan pa zhig ma byung tshe khrims 'gal mgo mjug med pa'i rigs la rjes gnon tsha 'ded btang ngos yin pas/ 'di thams cad kyi spyi khyab tu spyi chen dang / dmigs bsal las thogs pa yod pas de'i kha 'og tu ja dpon/ tshwa gzigs/ lag bde ba mang ja len mi rnams kyis mtshon 'dir gtogs tshang mas 'du zhing nyan 'jog khur che gal che zhing / spyi las nas kyang phyogs cha nye ring spangs pa'i chos sde'i zhabs tog dkon mchog dpang bzhugs ngos gcur dgos tshang ma sgrig med bag yangs su mi 'gro ba'i do dam gang che dang / gzhung dang nged rang sogs mi ngo rnams dang / mkhan chen/ phyag gnyer/ spyi gzhung / nged rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ phyogs kyi sbyin bdag sku drag bcas kyi mang ja rnams las thog pa rang gis len/ gzhan tshang ma sbyin bdag so so rang gis skyel ba ma gtogs las thog pas thams cad len par phyin tshe chos sde'i las tshan gyi go sar gnod pas mi len/ go rim skul tshul zla re bzhin tshes gsum/ bdun/ brgyad/ bcu/ bco lnga/ gnam gang rnams kyi rnam rgyal dang / ri bya sder ma sogs lo rim gyi rnam rgyal rnams la grwa bcu gcig re/ chos sgrogs pa nyin ltar bzhi re dang / tshes bzhi/ bcu gcig bco lnga rnams la grwa nyer lnga re/ tshes brgyad gtor ma nyin gang mar grwa brgyad dang / mang ja grol nas bcu gcig tshes drug dang bcu gsum gyi kun rig re mos dang / bco lnga cho ga rnams la grwa nyer gcig re bcas dus rnams bskul 'phros nas nged rang zhal ngo rnams kyi rim gro 'phar ma rnams chos skabs chos grwa grol bstun gtong rgyur go rim du bskul ba ma gtogs dmigs bsal gyis mi bskul/

gzhan sger pa rnams mang ja grol bstun rang rang gi mchod gnas 'tshol ba ma gtogs gzhung las dang bsres pa'i mnyam 'dur mi byed/ lo dus kyi mang ja zhu dgos tshang ma lag deb zur gsal bzhin dang / 'gyed bgrang dgos rnams kyang snga thog thob thang gang yod la chad lhag med par byed/ dbyar dgun gyi gzhis len/ gcig skyur/ rig cha sogs kyi mchod dpon dang / sba dbyug khyer nas do dam byed dgos kyi rigs/ gung gseng bsdu brda'i 'khar rnga brdung ba sogs mdor na las thog pa'i byed dgos tshang mar khral 'jal stong min tsam du ma song bar las tshan don ldan yong ba'i sems khur bskyed pa dang / gzhan gyis mi rtsi ba'i rigs shar tshe yi ge 'di mig ltar khra bzung bgyis ngos spang blang go 'dzol med pa gal che zhes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lha khang chen mo'i dge 'dun g.yos khang gi las byed rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
